intendedChanges.summary: Shorten the replacement-meter deadline from sixty to thirty days; Operator can counter by excluding documented vendor delays beyond its control.
Increase reporting frequency from quarterly to monthly.
Increase contractual inspection notice from five to ten business days while preserving independent statutory powers.
Reduce the negotiated administrative penalty from $48,000 to $24,000.
Raise the daily stipulated assessment from $250 to $1,000; Operator can counter with a total cap for a single missed deadline.
Move the unchanged confidential-information clause from Section 4 to Section 9.
Replace keep with retain in the modification-record sentence without changing the duty.
Clarify the effective-date wording without changing the triggering event.
